architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: The client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Backend
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module Service
architectural_units.description: This service has the main function of obtaining and processing data from playlogs, connections and platform actions.

architectural_units.name: Player API Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players, receiving all the information corresponding to them.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket Service
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players.

architectural_units.name: Database
architectural_units.description: MySQL database that is responsible for storing all the data necessary for the operation of the system.

architectural_units.name: Cloud Storage Service
architectural_units.description: A data lake formed by AWS services to store all history for processing.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Backend framework used to develop the different services.

architectural_units.name: TypeScript
architectural_units.description: Programming language used for the backend.

architectural_units.name: AWS
architectural_units.description: Cloud services used for infrastructure.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Object storage service used to store JSON documents.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: NoSQL database service used for real-time storage of playlogs.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Data integration service used for metadata storage and cataloging.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Service for data ingestion and streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service for loading large amounts of data into data stores.

architectural_units.name: Player
architectural_units.description: A device that allows screens to play content.

architectural_units.name: HTTP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol between presentation and business layers.

architectural_units.name: TCP
architectural_units.description: Communication protocol between services.
The presentation layer communicates with the business layer, more specifically with the Api Gateway, using the HTTP protocol.
The communication between the Api Gateway service and the other services (Core, Analytical Module, Player API, Web Socket) is via the TCP communication protocol.
The Web Socket service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players, and in this way allows the exchange of information between them.
The Core service interacts with the database, although it also interacts to a lesser extent with cloud services.
The analytical module mainly interacts with cloud services, although it also interacts to a lesser extent with the database.
The Web Socket service processes the data coming from the players and stores them in the database and in the cloud services.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Layered Architecture
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
